# Wired Geese

Wired Geese is Alex Gusev's public software-making practice. The human website is maintained in English (`en`), Russian (`ru`), and Spanish (`es`).

Journal and Library articles are authored in locale-specific Markdown and rendered at their localized `.html` URLs. This file curates the English Markdown corpus for agent discovery. Russian and Spanish Markdown article URLs are also publicly retrievable directly; they are omitted from this English discovery list.
